project_name: MikiLab Mobile-First Web App - Calm Italian & German Artisan Design System
target_audience: Professional & Amateur Bakers, Pastry Chefs, Pizzerias & Multi-store Food Businesses (IT/DE/EN)

core_design_philosophy.concept: Calm Italian & German Artisan Fusion ('Mantieni colori calmi ma aggiungi colori italiani e tedeschi come ordine primario')
core_design_philosophy.tagline: Unica al mondo, semplice, senza tempo
core_design_philosophy.owner_directive: Mantieni colori calmi ma aggiungi colori italiani e tedeschi come ordine primario. (Keep colors calm, but integrate Italian and German national colors as the primary organizing theme).
key_principles: No Feature Destruction: Refine, harmonize, and elevate existing workflows incrementally without deleting functionality or routes.
Calm IT+DE Cultural Palette: Muted Italian Sage Green, Shared Terracotta Red, German Sourdough Amber/Gold, German Deep Charcoal, and Warm Flour Cream.

Signature IT/DE Flag Ribbon: A subtle 3px/4px top micro-ribbon gradient or multi-stripe motif representing Italian (Green/White/Red) and German (Black/Red/Gold) heritage without loud background fills.
Saturation & Lightness Ceilings: Max 25-45% saturation for card fills and backgrounds, max 60-65% for active accents to maintain a calm, premium, non-garish aesthetic.
Mobile-First Tactility: High-contrast touch targets, smooth glassmorphism headers, thumb-friendly bottom nav, and high legibility under bakery kitchen lighting.

color_system.description: Sophisticated, calm palette integrating Italian (Green, Cream, Red) and German (Charcoal Black, Terracotta Red, Sourdough Gold) national accents as muted primary organizational tokens.

shared_red.name: Muted Terracotta / Rust Red
shared_red.role: Shared Italian & German Red accent. Used for primary CTAs, active highlights, key alerts, and primary buttons.

shared_gold_amber.name: Warm Sourdough Gold / Amber
shared_gold_amber.role: Shared German Gold & Sourdough fermentation accent. Used for AI Maestro highlights, sourdough timers, XP badges, and dark-mode micro-glows.

italian_green.name: Muted Sage / Forest Green
italian_green.role: Italian Green national accent. Used for secondary actions, sourdough freshness status, success states, and Pizzeria/Laboratorio tags.

german_charcoal.name: German Deep Charcoal Black
german_charcoal.role: German Charcoal Black national accent. Primary body text in light mode, background anchor for dark mode and tactical cards.

flour_cream.name: Soft Flour Cream / Warm Alabaster
flour_cream.role: Shared Italian & German White/Cream flour surface. Default light-mode background and soft card contrast.

saturation_and_lightness_ceilings.card_background_saturation: Maximum 15% saturation in light mode, 14% in dark mode (prevents background visual clutter).
saturation_and_lightness_ceilings.accent_stroke_saturation: Maximum 65% saturation for active borders, icons, and status badges (keeps colors calm and earthy).
saturation_and_lightness_ceilings.dark_mode_anchor: #12100F (Deep German Charcoal) with subtle gold ambient micro-glow shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(200,138,43,0.15)].

shared_it_de_ribbon.description: 5-stripe micro-ribbon combining Italian & German national colors seamlessly: Green -> Cream -> Red -> Gold -> Charcoal.
shared_it_de_ribbon.tailwind_class: h-1 w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#4A7265] via-[#A64B2A] to-[#C88A2B]

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: font-display text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight text-stone-900 dark:text-stone-100
hierarchy_rules.h2_section: font-display text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-stone-900 dark:text-stone-100
hierarchy_rules.h3_card: font-sans text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold tracking-snug text-stone-800 dark:text-stone-200
hierarchy_rules.body_base: font-sans text-sm sm:text-base font-normal leading-relaxed text-stone-700 dark:text-stone-300
hierarchy_rules.data_metric: font-mono-data text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium tracking-wide text-stone-600 dark:text-stone-400
hierarchy_rules.label_caps: font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-bold text-stone-500 dark:text-stone-400

card_and_hierarchy_system.clutter_elimination_strategy: Transition from loud full-gradient card grids to 4 disciplined surface tiers with semantic borders, soft ambient elevation, and calm IT/DE micro-accents.

tier_1_standard_card.classes: bg-white dark:bg-[#1B1715] border border-stone-200/80 dark:border-stone-800/80 shadow-sm rounded-2xl p-5 hover:border-stone-300 dark:hover:border-stone-700 transition-all duration-200
tier_1_standard_card.usage: Recipe list items, enciclopedia entries, store cards, basic settings, form containers

tier_2_hero_accent_card.classes: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#A64B2A] to-[#85371B] text-white shadow-md rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden border border-[#A64B2A]/30
tier_2_hero_accent_card.usage: Primary Dashboard CTA, Michele Talking Avatar Card, Production Plan Hub Hero

tier_3_artisan_glass_card.classes: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/85 dark:bg-[#1B1715]/85 border border-stone-200/60 dark:border-stone-800/60 shadow-lg rounded-2xl p-5
tier_3_artisan_glass_card.usage: Sticky Nav bar, Floating action bars, Modal overlays, Sound/Photo diagnosis dialogs

tier_4_command_tactical_card.classes: bg-[#1E1B18] text-stone-100 border-l-4 border-l-[#C88A2B] border-stone-800 shadow-xl rounded-2xl p-6
tier_4_command_tactical_card.usage: AI Maestro Sa Tutto, Piano di Produzione (IA) calculations, Smart Scale & Haccp logs

it_de_flag_ribbon.css_class: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#4A7265] via-[#A64B2A] to-[#C88A2B] h-[3px] w-full
it_de_flag_ribbon.description: Signature 3px top border ribbon combining Italian Sage Green, Shared Terracotta Red, and German Gold Amber.

flour_dust_texture.description: Subtle 2% opacity organic grain overlay on page background that conveys tactile artisanal warmth without impeding legibility.

golden_crust_glow.description: Subtle ambient drop shadow `shadow-[0_0_18px_rgba(200,138,43,0.18)]` used on active XP badges, primary buttons, and live sourdough timers.

sourdough_pill_badge.classes: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono-data bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/20
sourdough_pill_badge.description: Clean pill badge displaying hydration %, dough temperature °C, or fermentation hours.

general_rules: Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='explore-recipes-btn', data-testid='production-wizard-step-1').
Header and Dropdown components MUST NOT use fully transparent backgrounds. Use backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 or bg-[#12100F]/90.
Use sonner for toast notifications across all user actions.

Header_js.styling: Sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 dark:bg-[#12100F]/85 border-b border-stone-200/60 dark:border-stone-800/60 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between

BottomNav_js.styling: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#12100F]/90 border-t border-stone-200/80 dark:border-stone-800/80 px-2 py-2 flex justify-around items-center max-w-lg mx-auto

MikiAvatar_js.styling: Rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg border-2 border-[#C88A2B]/30 hover:border-[#C88A2B] transition-all cursor-pointer relative

PianoProduzioneAI_js.styling: Tier 4 Command Tactical Card layout with responsive grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6), step wizard navigation, printable recipe export triggers.

prioritized_rollout_order.title: Global Design Tokens & CSS Variables with IT+DE Palette
prioritized_rollout_order.action: Inject refined HSL CSS variables for calm Italian Sage Green, Terracotta Red, German Sourdough Gold, and Charcoal Black for light & dark modes.

prioritized_rollout_order.title: Header & Bottom Navigation Glassmorphism with Signature IT/DE Micro-Ribbon
prioritized_rollout_order.action: Apply backdrop-blur-xl, top 3px IT/DE flag ribbon motif, remove full transparency, and add data-testid attributes.

prioritized_rollout_order.title: Home Dashboard & Michele Talking Avatar
prioritized_rollout_order.action: Replace chaotic gradient grids with Tier 1 & 2 cards, clean 'Esplora MikiLab' 7-section grid, and responsive video player overlay.

prioritized_rollout_order.title: Il Tuo Laboratorio & Piano Produzione AI
prioritized_rollout_order.action: Unify 3-step wizard with Tier 4 Command Tactical styling, clear supplier order quick-links, and printable label triggers.

prioritized_rollout_order.title: Catalogues, Diagnosis & Multi-Store Enterprise
prioritized_rollout_order.action: Standardize recipe cards with sourdough pill badges, calm IT/DE accent tagging, and PDF batch export triggers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read /app/design_guidelines.json completely before modifying any component.
Follow the 5-step prioritized rollout order strictly to prevent regressions.
Ensure ALL interactive elements receive explicit data-testid attributes.
Never delete any existing section, route, data model, or helper function; enhance UI/UX and styling incrementally.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_requirement: All buttons, inputs, tabs, recipe items, language switchers, and dialog actions MUST retain or add data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent header or overlay dropdown backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_library: Use sonner for user feedback toasts.
